11K likes, 39 comments - bharatzkitchen on September 30, 2026: "Swiggy Zomato hi better tha @prerna.kapoor 🤪🤪🤪

Achari Shimlamirch

1 Capsicum (Shimlamirch)
1 Onion (Bulbs)
2 Onions (Finely Chopped)
1 Tomato
1/2 tsp Fenugreek Seeds

Curd Mix
1/2 Cup Curd
2 tsp Coriander Powder
1/2 tsp Garam Masala

For Cooking
1 Ladle Mustard Oil
1 tsp Cumin Seeds
1 tsp Fennel Seeds
1/2 tsp Mustard Seeds
3 Green Chillies
1 Tbsp Ginger Garlic Paste
1/2 tsp Turmeric Powder
1 tsp Kashmiri Red Chilli Powder
1/2 tsp Red Chilli Powder
1 tsp Salt
1 Tbsp Besan
1 Tbsp Jaggery
1/2 tsp Garam Masala
1 tsp Kasuri Methi
1 Tbsp Malai
Coriander Leaves

#bharatzkitchen #new #subzi #spicy #unique".
